subject: Dinosaurs and fossil evidence
learningGoals: Compare estimated body lengths using the same scale and explain why estimates can be ranges.
Connect a visible fossil feature to a supported inference while recognizing uncertainty.
Use a timeline to identify whether two selected animals could have lived at the same time.
researchToComplete: Select specimens or taxa with trustworthy museum or scientific sources.
Verify length estimates, time intervals, fossil provenance, and reconstruction limits.
Obtain suitable illustration or photograph rights and record attribution.
